info.title: uicast OpenAPI demo
info.description: The demo's own API. Because it is built from Vovk controllers, `vovk generate` emits an OpenAPI document for it — which the app can then connect to as an API like any other.

isError.description: Indicates that this object represents an error

from @uicast/openapi_demo import ConnectionController

response = ConnectionController.get_connections()

print(response)
[
    {
        "id": -9007199254740991,
        # Short identifier, and the prefix of every derived tool name.
        "name": "string",
        # URL of the API's OpenAPI document.
        "openapiUrl": "string",
        "authType": "none",
        # Header or query parameter carrying the credential.
        "authName": "string",
        # Whether a credential is stored. The credential itself is never returned.
        "configured": true,
        "createdAt": "string"
    }
]

x-codeSamples.source:
from @uicast/openapi_demo import ConnectionController

response = ConnectionController.create_connection(
    body={
        # Short identifier for the API, e.g. `stripe`.
        "name": "pattern-string",
        # URL of the API's OpenAPI document.
        "openapiUrl": "https://example.com",
        # How the credential travels with each request.
        "authType": "none"
    },
)

print(response)
{
    "id": -9007199254740991,
    # Short identifier, and the prefix of every derived tool name.
    "name": "string",
    # URL of the API's OpenAPI document.
    "openapiUrl": "string",
    "authType": "none",
    # Header or query parameter carrying the credential.
    "authName": "string",
    # Whether a credential is stored. The credential itself is never returned.
    "configured": true,
    "createdAt": "string",
    # The operations this API now exposes. They become callable functions on the next turn, not this one.
    "operations": [
        "string"
    ]
}
